newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP August copper, coal, iron ore up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP August copper, coal, iron ore up.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday that August production of iron ore, coal and copper in concentrate rose when compared with a year ealier, while steel, oil and gas output slipped.

Iron ore production rose three percent to 4.70 million tonnes in August. Coal production was five percent higher at 1.98 millon tonnes. Output of copper in concentrate rose 42 percent in August to 60,400 tonnes, while steel production slipped 4.0 percent to 730,000 tonnes, BHP said.
Petroleum liquids -- crude oil and condensate -- slipped 2.0 percent to 5.72 million barrels, the company said.
Liquefied natural gas production slid 1.0 percent to 107,100 tonnes in August from August 1995.
